people.name: Jubal
people.line: Father of musicians who play the lyre and pipe

translations.web: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
translations.bsb: And his brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play the harp and flute.
translations.kjv: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
translations.asv: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and pipe.
